name: Return to Quinn (Again)

angles.text: Quinn Yorick fears becoming a mindless ghoul. His plight shows how the Forsaken struggle to preserve their free will and physical faculties.
Helping distressed travelers and outcasts in Silverpine Forest strengthens Horde influence in the plagued lands north of the Sepulcher.

faq.answer: Quinn Yorick is an afflicted traveler at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He needs special alchemical mixtures to stave off physical decline and regain enough strength to travel.

aliases: why does quinn need a potion
faq.answer: Quinn's Potion is a special mixture made to aid his recovery and keep his condition from worsening. Without it, he feared he would deteriorate into a mindless ghoul.
faq.q: What is Quinn's Potion and why does he need it?

faq.answer: The Ivar Patch lies directly north of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. It is Quinn Yorick's temporary shelter while he recovers.
faq.q: Where is the Ivar Patch located?

aliases: what is quinn potion made of
faq.answer: Quinn's remedy is an alchemical mixture brewed from extracts of six whole hearts. It is meant to halt his bodily decay.
faq.q: What are the ingredients in Quinn's potion?

aliases: does quinn turn into a ghoul
faq.answer: The potion takes effect as soon as Quinn drinks it. He says he will soon be strong enough to travel again instead of becoming a ghoul.
faq.q: Does the potion successfully cure Quinn Yorick?

faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher brews Quinn's potion from the extract of six whole hearts. Impatient with paperwork, he hands it over and is eager to dismiss the courier.
faq.q: Who brews the potion for Quinn?

sections.body: North of the Sepulcher, Quinn Yorick rests at the Ivar Patch in Silverpine Forest. His affliction threatens both mind and body, so a special alchemical mixture brewed from six hearts is sent to his camp. For the Forsaken and their allies, bringing remedies to wandering kin can hold back rot and madness.
sections.title: A Desperate Remedy

sections.body: Quinn Yorick feared he was nearing a grim end, becoming a mindless ghoul. He drinks the freshly brewed potion, and its effects come at once. His strength returns, and he can prepare to travel across the plagued land.
sections.title: Averting Degeneration

summary: At the Ivar Patch, Quinn Yorick needs a remedy before his affliction claims his mind and body. A courier brings him a mixture brewed from six hearts, restoring his strength for the travels ahead.
attribution: In-game quest text: Return to Quinn (Again)
